key_findings.detail: tools/run_joint_flight.py run(): construct before child creation (after line 758, before 780); start after physics.connect() (852) and immediately before the loop `while clock.tick < MAX_TICKS:` (878); stop at the top of the single outer `finally` (989) before cleanup_children (990). run() creates no Python threads and does not spin (rclpy.spin_once exists only in task_main), so all three calls are on the same launcher main thread that drives the 4-tick rate groups.

MIXED runs a single fixed 0.5 rate segment (make_joint_rate at 757; rate.set_rate is never called in this runner). The actual rate window is [rate.last_summary['anchor']['wall_ns'], rate.last_end]: anchor wall is stamped in JointRate.reanchor (joint_rate.py:52), last_end in end_group (joint_rate.py:141). This is the same segment audit_pv_trajectory.rate_windows() validates (len(segments)==1, anchor requested_rate 0.5, groups[-1].end_tick == final_authority.tick). Both Python time.monotonic_ns and the recorder CLOCK_MONOTONIC share one clock domain.

The strict consumer requires wksim.perf_windows.v1 to bind boot_id/owner_pid/owner_tid/clock_id and to keep each window inside the inner enabled span [enable_after_ns, disable_before_ns] (perf_stream_consumer.py:396-451). The runner already has every needed value: Simulator/wksim_runtime/evidence.py:host_boot_id() matches the C boot_id format (36-char dashed UUID, truncated at newline, wksim_perf_stream.c:358-385) and PerfStreamCapture.owner_pid/owner_tid equal C getpid()/gettid() (wksim_perf_stream.c:679-680).

Run_joint_flight.py consumes only CLI manifest/SHA pairs; the new-architecture deployment document cannot carry the perf pin because experiment_bundle.resolve enforces set(deployment)=={'schema_version','firmware_releases'} and set(release)=={'family','target','vehicle_model','manifest_linux','manifest_sha256'} (experiment_bundle.py:61-69). Recommended input is the optional --perf-library/--perf-library-sha256 pair (MIXED only), with the library path/SHA/kernel/boot recorded in the run result; no parallel deployment parser may be added.

Outputs live/perf-switch.raw, live/perf-switch.meta.json, live/perf-windows.json in the fresh mkdtemp `live` (parent exists, outputs absent, raw != meta), later sealed by the existing shutil.copytree(live, archive) at line 1039. Failure policy must be fail-closed: requested capture that is not complete must force result['status'] != 'pass' in the status reduction at lines 1031-1035, and the stop must run before cleanup_children so teardown can never lose the evidence; the stop block must never raise out of finally.

Add Simulator/wksim_runtime/perf_capture.py (and optionally the recorder C/H) to `sources` (383-418) when requested. result['source_sha256'], live/source__*.txt and source_unchanged are all generated from the same dict, which preserves the strict equality audit_mixed_control.py:143-146 and audit_pv_trajectory.py:305-308 impose. The library is not archived (policy: no .so publication); record path + SHA + kernel + boot and re-digest after stop. Do not add perf fields to result['bounds'], which auditors compare exactly (audit_mixed_control.py:123-124).

Run the pinned consumer (dee9a3b5...) on the archive after the runner exits: --raw/--metadata/--windows/--require-kernel-counter --output <archive>/perf-decoded.json (a new filename; the tool refuses overwrite). Run it before tools/audit_mixed_control.py so the audit's all-file evidence_sha256 (audit_mixed_control.py:822) seals perf-decoded.json. Nothing from the decode may be written back into result.json.

joint_profile._mixed_proofs (Simulator/wksim_runtime/joint_profile.py:274-276) rejects formal mixed/PV evidence only for presence of 'rate_timing_probe' or 'group_work_timing'. The perf marker must be added to that presence check (and covered by pure tests) before any instrumented MIXED run may exist; otherwise a diagnostic-marker run could be admitted as formal MIXED/PV evidence. This audit does not claim that the formal gate permits diagnostic markers. Raw flight auditors deliberately tolerate diagnostics (audit_mixed_control.py:132-134 lists only alternate workflows), matching the rate_timing_probe precedent.

The plan touches no pacing/tick code: SceneClock.STEP_NS=1_000_000 / MACRO_TICKS=4, JointRate no-catch-up release (earliest=max(ideal, previous_start+period)), LATE_LIMIT_NS=100_000_000, complete 10s/60s sliding-window rate gates, and every identity/physical gate (sources, manifests, control_shutdown_clean, cleanup_errors, unowned_ap, truth bounds, native maps) stay exactly as they are. joint_rate.py is not modified (validation/test_joint_rate_probe.py:28 hard-pins its SHA 0b53a16a...).
